subject: Re: POC next steps & scope — AcmeCorp (success criteria + timeline)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>
To: Tom Phillips <t.phillips@acmecorp.com>, Hannah Lee <hannah.lee@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.inference>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: POC next steps recap + success criteria (follow-up)

Hi Tom / Hannah —

Thanks again for the call earlier — great to hear how AcmeCorp is thinking about deploying Redwood for the internal knowledge assistant and the customer support triage flows. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment: 

1) Scope (initial POC):
   - Knowledge assistant (internal): ingest 3 months of internal KB + 50k support tickets, evaluate answer relevance and hallucination rate.
   - Support triage prototype (sample): routing suggestions for Tier 1 tickets (10k ticket subset).

2) Success criteria (proposed):
   - Knowledge assistant: >0.75 MRR (mean reciprocal rank) on the evaluated prompt set, <5% factual hallucination rate on 200 random samples.
   - Support triage: >80% match rate vs human routing on sample set, average latency <600ms per request under expected load.

3) Timeline (proposed):
   - Data handoff: by 2026-02-25 (S3 bucket + sample ticket export)
   - Setup & baseline runs: 2 business days after data receipt
   - Evaluation window: 2 weeks; rebaseline at end if scope changes

4) Owners:
   - Redwood: Marissa (POC lead), Rachel (integration), Neha (SRE / perf)
   - Acme: Tom (POC sponsor), Hannah (data/eng lead)

5) Next steps:
   - You confirm data access and timeline
   - We share the success criteria spreadsheet and a one-page MOP (attached)

Please review and tell me if you'd like any of the criteria tightened/relaxed. If this looks good we can lock the POC and I’ll send the DocuSign SOW for the reserved pilot capacity.

Thanks —
Marissa
Marissa Cole | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.inference | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: poc-success-criteria.xlsx (spreadsheet), acme-mop-v1.pdf (method of play)
From: Tom Phillips <t.phillips@acmecorp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>
Cc: Hannah Lee <hannah.lee@acmecorp.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.inference>
Date: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC next steps recap + success criteria (follow-up)

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap — this looks good and aligns with what we discussed. A couple of asks/notes from our side after talking it over internally: 

1) Additional use case: we'd like to add a third, smaller use case mid-POC — an automated response suggestion flow for our billing inquiries (approx 3k tickets). This is lower priority but would be valuable to validate before a full rollout.

2) Success criteria: for the support triage, can we add a secondary metric for false-positive routing (we'd like <10% incorrect auto-routes that would send to the wrong team)?

3) Timeline impact: adding the billing flow may push the evaluation window by ~5 business days. We'll aim to get the data to you the week of 2/23 but confirming with our data team.

If you can send an updated success criteria + timeline (rebaseline) that includes the billing use case, we'll review internally and confirm.

—Tom
Tom Phillips | Director, Product Operations — AcmeCorp
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>
To: Tom Phillips <t.phillips@acmecorp.com>, Hannah Lee <hannah.lee@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.inference>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.inference>
Date: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 11:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC next steps recap + success criteria (follow-up)

Tom —

Great, thanks for the quick read. We can accommodate the billing response-suggestion use case. Attached is an updated MOP and the success-criteria workbook (poc-success-criteria.xlsx) renamed v2 with the added rows for the billing flow and the false-positive routing metric. Highlights of changes:

- Billing response-suggestion (3k tickets): evaluation focuses on suggested-response accuracy vs human editor acceptance rate (>70% acceptance) and latency (<500ms median).
- Support triage: added false-positive rate target <10% as requested.
- Timeline: evaluation window extended by 5 business days; new target completion = 2026-03-12 assuming data by 2/25.

Action items for Acme:
- Confirm data export for billing tickets + sample schema by 2026-02-23
- Confirm DocuSign SOW approval path (names + signer)

I'll route this to our Legal/Finance team to get the SOW ready; Rachel can you start the reserved capacity estimate (2 GPU nodes, burst to 4) and Neha can scope perf run timing?

Marissa
